notes: Sepolia-only deployment (chain ID 11155111), with seven contracts in dependency order. $contract references resolve to earlier deployments; owner, initial royalty recipients and MockOG initial recipient use $owner. MockOG has 18 decimals, a one-trillion initial supply and unrestricted public minting; it is not a capped production token. MockSwarmPepe allows public minting of unused Pepe IDs to the caller. Both mocks are Sepolia-only (also used in local tests); never use this manifest on mainnet. Furniture starts with 5% royalties bounded at 10%. Staking uses one point per whole token per day (1e18 point units), with its existing rounded-up 1% unstake fee sent to the vault. The raffle uses raffleNotice=0. No OGClubBox is deployed. The factory makes constructor calls only. Before opening raffles, $owner must execute furniture.grantMinter(raffle) as furniture's FIRST grant and staking.grantSpender(raffle) as staking's FIRST grant, using confirmed addresses; verify minters(raffle) and spenders(raffle). First grants are immediate; later grants activate from proposal+7 through proposal+14 days inclusive. Revocation is immediate. These remain documented owner steps, not manifest initialization calls. Mainnet raffle deployment uses the existing OG token, a fresh deployer, a Safe OWNER and RAFFLE_NOTICE=604800. OGClubClubs takes token, vault, price, furniture, owner, royaltyReceiver, pepes, delegates and a static UpgradePrices struct. Its level2/level3/level4 fields flatten into the final three manifest words in declaration order; no constructor array is used. The supplied delegate.xyz v2 registry is configured; live availability must be checked before advertising delegation. Zero registry disables delegation. The current Pepe holder or its authorized delegate pays and receives club #pepeId, once per Pepe forever. Mint costs 100_000e18; level 2/3/4 upgrades cost 200_000e18/400_000e18/800_000e18. Immutable prices split floor(amount/2) to the burn sink and the remainder to the vault, with exact payer debit and final receipt checks. Levels 1..4 give rooms 10x10 through 16x16, preserving coordinates. Floor stride is 16; door cells (0,4) and (1,4) stay clear. Wall side 0 follows y=0; side 1 follows x=0 and reserves position 4. Each club holds one permanent piece per design, at most 285 pieces (254 floor plus 31 wall). Furniture follows club transfers. Clubs start with sale closed, empty metadata and unset footprints. OWNER configures setFootprint(id,w,h,wall), metadata and sale opening; the sample JSON catalogue is Sepolia-only. Footprints lock on first placement. URI freezing does not freeze furnishing or room upgrades. Mainnet clubs use existing OG_TOKEN, FARM_VAULT, FURNITURE and SWARM_PEPES, with DELEGATE_REGISTRY, CLUB_PRICE and comma-separated UPGRADE_PRICES from env. The script checks FARM_VAULT.token() == OG_TOKEN before deploying from DEPLOYER_KEY, passes OWNER (which may be a Safe), and prints owner configuration calldata without broadcasting owner calls. Neither mock is deployed on mainnet. See README.md for protocol assumptions, admin powers and handoff details. No live deployment, signing or broadcast was performed in this assignment.
